changeSet.author: SaltyRain
changeSet.comment: Convert trades into a RANGE-partitioned table using trade_date as the partition key.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE trades RENAME TO trades_legacy;

CREATE TABLE trades ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, trade_ref VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, instrument_id BIGINT NOT NULL, counterparty_id BIGINT NOT NULL, asset_class VARCHAR(100), side VARCHAR(10), quantity NUMERIC(18,2), price NUMERIC(18,4), trade_date DATE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(50), deleted_at TIMESTAMP NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, modified_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
CONSTRAINT pk_trades_id PRIMARY KEY (id, trade_date),
CONSTRAINT uk_trades_trade_ref UNIQUE (trade_ref, trade_date),
CONSTRAINT fk_trades_instrument FOREIGN KEY (instrument_id) REFERENCES instruments(id),
CONSTRAINT fk_trades_counterparty FOREIGN KEY (counterparty_id) REFERENCES counterparties(id) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (trade_date);
